newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica nearing record annual murder rate.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica nearing record annual murder rate.

text.p: Jamaican police officials on Friday reported there had been 879 murders in the Caribbean nation by Dec. 11, raising the possibility that 1996 would be Jamaica's bloodiest year ever.
The previous record was 889, set during the violent general election year of 1980. There were 780 murders in Jamaica in 1995.

Jamaica launched a strong anti-crime plan in October, including a bid to hire more police, but hiring of 350 new officers had been put on hold because the government lacked funds to upgrade training facilities needed for the recruits.
Officials said the money needed was expected to become available during the first quarter of 1997.
